name: Mullvad Browser
tagline: Free the internet from mass surveillance
blurb: A hardened browser tuned against fingerprinting, made with the Tor Project — no VPN required.
description:
The Mullvad Browser is a privacy-focused web browser developed in a collaboration
 between Mullvad VPN and the Tor Project. It’s designed to minimize tracking and
 fingerprinting. You could say it’s a Tor Browser to use without the Tor Network.
 Instead, you can use it with a trustworthy VPN. The idea is to provide one more
 alternative – beside the Tor Network – to browse the internet with more privacy. To get
 as many people as possible to fight the big data gathering of today. To free the
 internet from mass surveillance.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distro, sandboxed and always up to date.

install.label: Homebrew
install.note: Or plain `brew install mullvad-browser` for the command-line build if the cask is missing.

install.label: Build from source
install.note: For contributors and people whose distro has no package yet.

summary: Free the internet from mass surveillance
